note: COX 'no eta' under a 'Selected Reason: CC - Parts Ordered.' template is a parts-ETA negation, but _negKind (wo-extract-dates.js) only looks 20 chars either side for 'part(s)' and otherwise defaults to techOnsite. On the live AUVTE COX units 17 of 25 'no eta' negations are techOnsite, all logged after COX had already recorded 'Actual technician arrival date time' (here 2026-11-04T04:22:22Z). Only comments that repeat 'parts ordered' right before 'no eta' land on partsArrival.
